##


Animal Hospital Fan Roleplay Versions


#


The viral success of the main horror game has inspired several fan-made roleplay variations on Roblox, e.g[Animal Hospital Roleplay](https://www.roblox.com/games/97678245226488/Animal-Hospital) ,[Animal Hospital (ROLEPLAY + SANDBOX)](https://www.roblox.com/games/133682851667896/Animal-Hospital-ROLEPLAY-SANDBOX) , where you can interact with the cast, morph into anomalies, or customize your characters (tails, ears, hats). Discord and[TikTok’s Animal Hospital Role Play tag](https://www.tiktok.com/discover/animal-hospital-role-play) keeps it going too, filled with fan edits of the cast. Animal Hospital fan roleplay experience is so appealing: people want to talk to the characters and steer the story, not just play it once.


An Animal Hospital Roleplay fanmade game on Roblox can get you part of the way there, but that’s built inside someone else’s server, where you’re watching or waiting your turn rather than directing the story or holding a real conversation with a character you love.


*Redbean* takes a different approach: Your time with the Animal Hospital characters doesn’t have to end when the shift does. You can **create your own versions of Ratthew, Dr. Harlow, or Barney** , rewrite the lore, and see how each reacts to a mystery you get to write yourself. (This[Animal Hospital character guide](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-characters) covers who they are first, if you need it.)


##


How to Create Animal Hospital Ship in Redbean or Roleplay With the Cast


#


**[Redbean](https://www.redbean.ai/)** ( *free-to-play, with optional IAP* ) is a creative playground for **writing stories and roleplaying** with your favorite characters: **create your own interactive OC** , bring it to life in a pixel town, and talk to it freely as part of story-driven gameplay. Here’s how to bring an Animal Hospital Ratthew, or any character from the cast, into it:


✨ **Recreate the character** : beyond simply[creating classes, skins, or Roblox avatars](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-oc-maker) based on in-game characters, you can ***create a playable character*** in seconds using a reference image or screenshot of[Ratthew](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/rattew-yqemxk28ff46) ,[Dr. Harlow](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/doctor-harlow-prgqwvuo1nj2) ,[Ron from Accounting](https://www.redbean.ai/characters/ron-from-accounting-g7lluo32rfo7) , Barney, or even a sketch of your own OC, or you can also draw it from scratch.


*Ratthew, Barney and Dr Harlow created by Redbean users (source:[Redbean character gallery](https://redbean.ai/characters) )*


💬 **Write their persona and lore** : You have complete creative freedom in defining *who they are* and *how they behave* . Lean into what’s already canon (Ratthew’s paranoia and the search for Rattina, Dr. Harlow’s grading routine, Ron’s bluntness about the hospital) or take them anywhere in your own imagination.


💗 **Set their relationship and connection:** Canon relationship (sister-brother like Ratthew and Rattina) or any *animal hospital Roblox ship* built entirely from your own imagination, not the game’s script. For example, **Ratthew and Secret Agent** could be partners investigating the “Shadow” experiment, or **Secret Agent and Intern** with “cool guy x chaotic intern” chemistry, or pair **Barney** with **Officer Duckman** – a serious, clumsy cop and a mischievous, playful serial killer – from-enemy-to-lover fanfiction/lore ship. All stories are directed by you.


💬 **Talk to them, in character:** NPCs in Redbean are **entirely yours** – freely customize the personality, lore, and speaking style to best match your fictional characters. Open-ended conversation with NPCs that **respond in-character** and remember what you’ve told them within scenarios and storyline.


🏠 **Build your own living town:** Decorate and customize your town with different themes and styles, favorite furniture or items, from horror styles inspired by the original game to brighter settings. Write town lore, set the scenarios, let all characters explore and shape the story, directed by you.


**Go beyond Animal Hospital if you want.** Nothing stops you from dropping the cast into the same town as characters from a completely different fandom, your own OCs or a multiverse, and seeing how that plays out.


**Redbean** is not a licensed Animal Hospital game, so it will not reproduce the Sanity meter, the anomaly-hunting, or the Classes system that make the original gameplay work. What it gives you instead is everything after your shift ends in the original game: **Your own version of Animal Hospital Roleplay** where your Ratthew, Dr. Harlow, Barney and the rest keep existing, talking, and *[building stories that you’re the main director.](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/free-cozy-life-sim-with-your-own-characters)*

##


FAQ About Animal Hospital Roblox Roleplay


#


###


Is there an official Animal Hospital roleplay game?


#


**No** . *Animal Hospital* is a[Roblox survival horror game](https://www.roblox.com/games/78515283254292/Animal-Hospital) with “spot the anomaly” puzzle gameplay (inspired by Phasmophobia) rather than a role-playing game. Besides the main gameplay, the developers haven’t released a dedicated roleplay mode. Most[Animal Hospital roleplay games](https://www.roblox.com/discover/?Keyword=animal%20hospital%20roleplay) currently available are fan-made, built by other Roblox creators.


###


How to roleplay with Animal Hospital characters like Ratthew?


#


In *Roblox Animal Hospital* , ******[Ratthew](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/roblox-animal-hospital-characters#Ratthew)****** is a central story NPC and one of the most beloved characters, known for his deep storyline and cute look that keep players captivated. In Redbean, you can recreate Ratthew from a reference image and define his lore/persona/speaking style: lean into his canon traits or rewrite them all. Then you can either play as Ratthew, or hold 1-on-1 chats with him as an NPC resident in your town, and the story keeps building the way you write it.


###


Can I roleplay as Ratthew, or anyone from the cast, somewhere other than Roblox?


#


**Yes** . In some of Roblox’s fanmade sandbox, you can play as other hospital staff or an anomaly, or stage scary roleplay with your friends. In **Redbean** , you can recreate Ratthew and Secret Agent, Ron, Secretary or any favorite Animal Hospital character from a reference image/photo, then hold a role-playing/conversation with them in your own town, outside the original game entirely.


###


What is Redbean, and how do I make an Animal Hospital ship in Redbean?


#


**Redbean** is a mobile sandbox that blends *character creation, social interaction, and story-driven play* . You can create a pixel version of Animal Hospital Ratthew, Dr. Harlow, Barney, etc. and play as one of the characters in a pixel town, or build your own **Animal Hospital ship** – pair the characters using relationship settings and the scene you write, let the story develop from there.


###


Besides characters from Animal Hospital, can I recreate other characters in Redbean?


#


Yes. **Redbean** allows you to[create original characters](https://redbean.ai/characters) from a reference image, photo, or drawing. Your favorite characters from movies, games, or your original characters can be turned **from a static image into interactive characters** , with personality traits and lore you define. Your town could be filled with characters like Ratthew, Secret Agent, Jax, Pomni, Batman, or Naruto, all within *a unique multiverse role-playing adventure* on Redbean (iOS and Android).
